title: Garrison / Workers
description: Worker nodes: capacity, leases, heartbeats, run execution as measured on the worker, event relay, completion reports, and harness availability.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Garrison node: the server pod or container name, or the worker node name.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.description: Harness type. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Served model as the harness reported it; none when it did not report one.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

list.name: search
list.label: Log text
list.description: Filters log panels to lines that contain this text.

panels.title: Workers up
panels.description: Worker metrics endpoints Prometheus scraped successfully.

targets.expr: sum(up{job="garrison", component="worker", node=~"$node"}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Ready nodes
panels.description: Worker nodes the control plane considers Ready (cluster-wide).

panels.title: Runs executing
panels.description: Runs in progress on the selected workers.

panels.title: Free slots
panels.description: Free run slots on the selected workers.

panels.title: Runs finished
panels.description: Runs the selected workers finished in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_worker_runs_total{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Pauses
panels.description: Process pauses (VM or container freeze) detected by the workers.

panels.title: Runs executing and free slots by node
panels.description: Capacity per worker.

panels.title: Nodes by status (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Worker nodes per status as stored by the control plane.

panels.title: Lease requests by result (per minute)
panels.description: Lease long polls and what came back: assigned, empty, error.

panels.title: Heartbeats (per minute)
panels.description: Heartbeats the workers sent (ok, error) and the control plane received (ok).

panels.title: Node state transitions
panels.description: Worker node transitions by new status (Registered, Ready, Draining, Lost, Offline).

panels.title: Control-plane call latency p95 by call
panels.description: Node protocol calls to the control plane (register, heartbeat, lease, watch, started, events, complete, token), 95th percentile. Long polls include their wait.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, operation) (rate(garrison_outbound_duration_seconds_bucket{service="control_plane", node=~"$node"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Control-plane calls by result (per minute)
panels.description: Node protocol calls by operation and result.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, result) (rate(garrison_outbound_requests_total{service="control_plane", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "operation", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Run duration on the worker
panels.description: Lease to completion report, per harness. Exemplar dots open the run trace.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_worker_run_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_worker_run_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Time to first token on the worker
panels.description: Harness process start to first model output, per harness.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_worker_run_ttft_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_worker_run_ttft_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Streaming time on the worker
panels.description: First to last model output, per harness.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_worker_run_streaming_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, harness) (rate(garrison_worker_run_streaming_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Worker stage p95
panels.description: Worker stages: workspace preparation, MCP pre-flight, execution, and completion report.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (rate(garrison_worker_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{node=~"$node", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "stage", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Runs finished on workers by outcome (per minute)
panels.description: Runs the workers finished, by outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(garrison_worker_runs_total{node=~"$node", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Completion reports and events
panels.description: Completion reports by result (accepted, stale, abandoned) and run events relayed (shipped, dropped).

panels.title: Harness probes by result
panels.description: Harness capability probes in the selected range, by harness and result.

targets.expr: round(sum by (harness, result) (increase(garrison_worker_capability_probes_total{node=~"$node"}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Worker pauses
panels.description: Pauses detected by each worker's heartbeat loop.

panels.title: Harness executions
panels.description: Worker spans around each harness process, nested in the run's trace.

panels.title: Worker logs
panels.description: Lines from the selected workers.

panels.title: Conversation directories swept
panels.description: Conversation work, home, and config directories each worker deleted after they went unused for ConversationRetentionHours. The next turn of a swept conversation falls back to a fresh session seeded with the transcript.

panels.title: Workspace cache hit rate by deployment

targets.expr: sum by (deployment, cache) (rate(garrison_worker_workspace_cache_total{result="hit"}[5m])) / sum by (deployment, cache) (rate(garrison_worker_workspace_cache_total[5m]))
